name: Treadmill
instructions: Step on with feet on the side rails and start the belt slowly.
Hold the rails as you step on.
Walk or run at a comfortable pace.
longevityNotes: Cardiovascular fitness is the single strongest predictor of a long, active life. Regular cardio work keeps the heart, lungs, and brain in shape for decades.
overview: Walking or running on a treadmill for cardio.
